verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets built-in agentic workflows: a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent. These auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases to human reviewers, so users can delegate alert triage to in-product AI. The evidence is marketing pages only and shows fixed, task-specific agents rather than a general assistant users can direct, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. missing for 10: an interactive or conversational assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to, first-party technical docs on agent behavior and controls, user-configurable delegation scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
